study: Paired-seed cluster bootstrap and exact paired randomization for LZ 2026 Parametric/Full S1 2D maps
bootstrap_resampling_unit: independent NEST production seed; Parametric and Full maps from each selected seed are resampled together
bootstrap_statistic: TV between separately normalized equal-weight arithmetic means of the resampled per-seed event-weighted rate maps

bootstrap_intervals.percentile: 2.5th and 97.5th empirical percentiles of the paired seed-cluster bootstrap distribution
bootstrap_intervals.basic: reflected interval [2*theta_hat - q97.5, 2*theta_hat - q2.5], lower-clipped at zero
bootstrap_intervals.interpretation: The TV functional is non-smooth and non-negative; percentile and basic intervals are reported as sensitivity diagnostics, not a formal equivalence interval. BCa was not used because the bias-correction tail was degenerate/extreme for several combinations with only ten clusters.

exact_randomization.method: enumerate all 2^10 within-seed Parametric/Full label swaps
exact_randomization.null: exchangeability of the paired mode labels at the independent-seed cluster level
exact_randomization.p_value: inclusive fraction of permutations with TV >= observed TV

support: native 10-phd by 0.02-dex histogram; four benchmarks, GCN/JJ55, NEST and WS-ROI stages
limitations: Ten independent seed clusters are a small sample; bootstrap intervals are method-sensitive for the non-smooth TV statistic.
Failure to reject the paired randomization null is not evidence of Parametric/Full equivalence.
No official waveform-level LZ reconstruction or detector-systematic covariance is included.
DAQ, SS/data-analysis, official FV, Skin/OD, and live-time migration remain absent.
No final profile likelihood or 90% CL exclusion is provided.
